params.name: _timeFrom
params.description: Start date and time of the search period in the format: YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss.sssZ

params.name: _timeTo
params.description: End date and time of the search period in the format: YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss.sssZ

params.name: logLevel
params.description: Filter by log level. CSV, case-insensitive. Valid values: Critical, Error, Warning, Information, Verbose.

params.name: logName
params.description: Filter by the full programmatic log name (e.g. Microsoft-FSLogix-Apps/Operational). Exact match, case-insensitive. CSV.

params.name: sourceName
params.description: Filter by event source/provider name. Exact match, case-insensitive. CSV.

params.name: eventId
params.description: Filter by Windows event ID. CSV.

params.name: machineName
params.description: Filter by machine name. Exact match, case-insensitive. CSV.

params.name: userName
params.description: Filter by user name (DOMAIN\User or SID-string fallback). Exact match, case-insensitive. CSV.

params.name: _sortBy
params.description: Response field to sort by. Default: eventTime.

params.name: _page
params.description: The page number returned. The first page is 1.

params.name: _limit
params.description: The number of items returned per page. Minimum is 1.

items.docs: Returns matched Event Log Monitoring rows (30-day rolling retention, filtered on event timestamp).
